# CORS Misconfiguration Checker

> Free tool: run a CLI that sends real requests with crafted Origin headers to your API, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on reflected-origin, null-origin, and unanchored allow-list CORS misconfigurations. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
